culture.text: A large engineering company of about 14,000 people, mostly electrical engineers and computer scientists working in engineering, operations and research.
Its work covers testing and design software for 6G, cars, IoT, AI data centres and quantum computing.

growth.text: Keysight bought Spirent Communications for USD 1.564 billion, a deal closed in October 2025.
Orders rose 56%, driven by AI demand.
